canonical_statement: Let G be a finite group of even order with no subgroup of index two. If S is a Sylow 2-subgroup of G and M is a maximal subgroup of S, then every involution of S has a G-conjugate in M.
domain_and_universes: universe u; G : Type u with Group G and Finite G; S : Sylow 2 G; M : Subgroup S; u : S; m : M; target Prop in universe 0
conclusion: There exists m : M such that IsConj (u : G) ((m : S) : G).
